changelog.title: Mobile UI Overhaul & Safe Background Lifecycle v1.0.1
changes: Fixed [object Object] console log formatting in the mobile terminal
Complete mobile dashboard overhaul: sleek topbar with live CPU/RAM stats & dedicated bottom navigation bar
Safe server shutdown on app swipe/destroy to prevent world corruption
Continuous background execution via persistent Android Foreground Service when minimized
Target SDK 28 execution permission fix for native OpenJDK binaries
Automated background update checks on app launch from GitHub repository

changelog.title: Initial Mobile Release (Android APK) v1.0.0
changes: Full Minecraft Java server management directly on Android phones (Android 6.0+)
Automated Adoptium Linux aarch64 ARM64 portable JRE manager & runtime
Background execution with persistent Foreground Service & CPU WakeLock to prevent server sleep
Responsive glassmorphism mobile UI with bottom navigation bar & touch gestures
Interactive Minecraft server console with virtual keyboard optimization
File Manager with batch operations, safe-guarding .mcmeta.json metadata
Full Modrinth plugin catalog browser & installer for mobile
World importer/exporter with ZIP compression support
Independent mobile update engine (separate from PC desktop releases)
